name: Love For Brains
source:
The city is lost to the undead, trapped in eternal night. Scarlet escapes into the forest with a stranger, chasing the memory of her uncle’s cabin. When they find it, their relief turns to dread. Two chained zombies wait within, desperate for freedom – and drawn to her heart.

[From [url=https://bibingkabunny.itch.io/love-for-brains]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这座城市被不死者迷失，被困在永恒的黑夜中。斯嘉丽和一个陌生人逃进森林，追寻她叔叔小屋的记忆。当他们找到它时，他们的轻松变成了恐惧。两个被锁链锁住的僵尸在里面等待着，渴望自由，并被她的心所吸引。

[来自[url=https://bibingkabunny.itch.io/love-for-brains]Itch.io[/url]]
